trap.label: whose
trap.wrong: This is the man which his car was stolen.
trap.right: This is the man whose car was stolen.
trap.why: Em português “cujo” é raro e usamos “que o carro dele”. Em inglês, whose já contém o possessivo: não repita his/her/its.

opts: tables, the results of them are clear
tables, the results of which are clear

mcq.why: which pode se referir à oração inteira.

fix.wrong: A chapter in that she dissects the headline.
fix.right: A chapter in which she dissects the headline.
fix.why: Preposição + which; that não segue preposição.

fix.wrong: The author whose her book is famous lives here.
fix.right: The author whose book is famous lives here.

fix.wrong: People who for it is new need help.
fix.right: People for whom it is new need help.

rewrite.prompt: Una com whose: “I know a writer. Her books sell well.”
rewrite.answer: I know a writer whose books sell well.

rewrite.prompt: Una com in which: “This is the chapter. She dissects the figure in it.”
rewrite.answer: This is the chapter in which she dissects the figure.

rewrite.prompt: Una com of which: “Here are tables. The results of the tables are clear.”
rewrite.answer: Here are tables, the results of which are clear.
